host_baseline.basis: measured once with the pinned host and a role's structured-output tool (athena.toml [agents]); not measured per invocation

input.basis: Claude Code result.modelUsage for the requested model

output.basis: Claude Code result.modelUsage for the requested model

cache_read.basis: Claude Code result.modelUsage for the requested model

cache_write.basis: Claude Code result.modelUsage for the requested model

cost.basis: Claude Code total_cost_usd, at list price

commands_run: cargo fmt --all && cargo test -p athena-context headroom 2>&1; cargo test -p athena-context reader_brief 2>&1; cargo test -p athena-core token_headroom 2>&1
cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings 2>&1; cargo test -p athena-cli --test budgets --test mirrors 2>&1; cargo test -p xtask --test policy 2>&1

policy_denials.detail: grep -n "capabilities" crates/athena-core/src/run_pin_tests.rs | head; grep -n "pub capabilities\|capabilities:" crates/athena-core/src/lib.rs | head
cargo fmt --all && cargo test -p athena-context headroom 2>&1 | tail -15; cargo test -p athena-context reader_brief 2>&1 | tail -5; cargo test -p athena-core token_headroom 2>&1 | tail -20

cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings 2>&1 | tail -n 5; cargo test -p athena-cli --test budgets --test mirrors 2>&1 | grep -E "test result|FAILED|failed"; cargo test -p xtask --test policy 2>&1 | grep -E "test result|FAILED|failed|rejected"
